decisions.statement: An offered quest is accepted before the menu is read.
A completion the game announced is answered before the menu is read.
Persuasion and intimidation come ahead of every other option.
Quest options come ahead of plain talk.
Plain talk is explored once per option per menu.
Selecting the same option at the same menu twice running is refused.
A menu offering a service is left alone until a quest has been acted on.
Leaving the dialogue forgets the state the dialogue built up.

definition: which dialogue option to take, worked out from the menu and what came before
